subject: INV-2026-07 — VAT question holding payment / proposed credit
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@orcahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: INV-2026-07 — initial overdue notice

Hi Emma,

Following up on invoice INV-2026-07 for $94,200 (due 2026-12-15). Our AR system shows this as 26 days past due. I’ve attached a copy of the invoice for reference.

Is there a preferred date when we should expect payment? If there’s a VAT or PO issue on your end, please let me know so we can avoid unnecessary bank rejections — we’re happy to coordinate with your procurement/tax team.

If helpful, we can propose a short payment plan or hold a 15-minute call to unblock.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: INV-2026-07.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Emma Carter <emma.carter@orcahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: INV-2026-07 — initial overdue notice

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the reminder. Our accounts team is holding payment pending confirmation on VAT treatment — for this engagement they say reverse-charge may apply but they need our tax advisors to sign off. That’s causing the wire to be rejected by our bank (they flagged the VAT line).

We also don’t have a purchase order on file for this invoice yet; procurement asked for a PO before releasing funds. I’ve opened a ticket with them but it could be 10–14 business days. Cash flow is tight right now; if a partial payment would reduce penalties, we could do 40% immediately once we have the PO.

I’m copying Luca (EMEA finance) who can provide the remittance screenshot and PO status.

Best,
Emma Carter
Head of Procurement, Orca Health
emma.carter@orcahealth.com

Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@orcahealth.eu>

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: INV-2026-07 — VAT/PO blocking payment — need leadership decision

Team — forwarding Orca’s note. Key points:
- Customer says reverse-charge VAT needs confirmation and has no PO yet.
- They offered 40% immediate payment once PO is issued; timing uncertain (~10 business days).
- Bank has rejected a previous wire citing VAT line mismatch (Luca will share screenshot).

Options I see: 1) Accept partial payment and hold dunning; 2) Offer a one-time goodwill credit (to net off late fees) contingent on full payment within X days; 3) Escalate to collections and start the formal dunning sequence now.

Ask: Markus / Marissa — can you advise on how aggressive we want to be here? If we offer credit, we should set firm terms (pay within 10 calendar days) and document in HubSpot/contract. If leadership OKs, I’ll propose a written offer and updated invoice.

Vivek
Account Executive

From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@orcahealth.eu>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Emma Carter <emma.carter@orcahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:41:00 +0100
Subject: Re: INV-2026-07 — VAT/PO blocking payment

Hi Vivek / Emma,

Attaching the remittance screenshot from our banking team — the wire was rejected with code: VAT_MISMATCH_EU. Procurement is moving the PO but needs one more internal approval (should be with you in 4–6 business days).

We are open to doing a 40% immediate payment as Emma mentioned once the PO posts. However, given month-end close I can’t promise faster than the 4–6 day window. If Redwood can provide an updated invoice that clarifies VAT handling (or applies reverse-charge notation), that would help the bank accept the transfer.

Thanks,
Luca Bianchi
EMEA Finance, Orca Health

Attachment: payment-remittance-screenshot.png (image/png)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 07:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: INV-2026-07 — VAT/PO blocking payment — need leadership decision

Thanks for the context — reviewed. Given the customer relationship and that procurement appears cooperative, I authorize a one-time goodwill credit of 10% (net of taxes) on INV-2026-07 on the condition that full payment (post-PO) is received within 10 calendar days of our updated invoice being issued. If payment is not received within that window we revert to standard terms and resume formal dunning.

Markus — please prepare an updated invoice reflecting the 10% credit and a short memo we can send to Orca that documents the condition (payment by date X). Vivek — please record this in HubSpot and mark the payment plan activity. Monica — loop CS if there are any service-impact concerns.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: (none)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@orcahealth.com>, Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@orcahealth.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INV-2026-07 — VAT question holding payment / proposed credit

Hi Emma / Luca,

Thanks for the quick responses and for sharing the remittance screenshot. Per leadership approval, Redwood will issue an updated invoice with a one-time 10% goodwill credit on INV-2026-07 (net of VAT) provided the full balance is paid within 10 calendar days of the updated invoice date.

Next steps we will take immediately:
- Finance (Markus) will send updated invoice ("updated-invoice-INV-2026-07-net-credit.pdf") showing the credit and clear reverse-charge notation for EU customers.
- Please confirm the PO number when it’s available so we can match the payment.
- Once PO is posted and you initiate a wire, if the bank still rejects for VAT formatting we will work with your finance team to adjust notation.

If the updated invoice and terms are acceptable, please confirm by reply and we’ll hold the dunning sequence while the 10-day window is open. If we don’t receive payment by the date on the updated invoice plus 10 days, we will resume standard collection steps.

Wire details and remittance instructions are included on the updated invoice.

Appreciate your partnership — we want to minimize operational friction here.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: updated-invoice-INV-2026-07-net-credit.pdf (application/pdf)
